data: ALTER TABLE webhook_request DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uq_webhook_request_nonce

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_audit_event (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, integration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_integration(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, request_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, error_code VARCHAR(64) NULL, result_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_webhook_audit_integration_time ON webhook_audit_event (integration_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_security_failure_bucket (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, integration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_integration(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, minute_bucket TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, last_request_id UUID NOT NULL, error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_failure_bucket UNIQUE (integration_id, minute_bucket, error_code))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_webhook_failure_bucket_time ON webhook_security_failure_bucket (integration_id, minute_bucket DESC)
